affectedRuntimeRoots: continuous recovery API workflow independent checker and fresh replay

applicability.rationale: The modified reader is invoked by the continuous-recovery HTTPS workflow and its fresh replay, and the 6d original checker failed at the exact invariant changed by this patch.

confidence.rationale: Patch bytes, base commit, two afterimages, callers, adapter source semantics, actual 6d public evidence, and focused negative partitions were all directly inspected.

impact.rationale: The patch changes only the isolated continuous-recovery evidence reader and its synthetic model, not the Go forwarding adapter or persisted state. A wrong gate could nevertheless falsely accept or reject a recovery evidence set.

materialBoundaries.counterexample: A PASS step fabricates bodyBytes zero or EOF or close success and is accepted as if the transport consumed the response.
materialBoundaries.invariant: A PASS/PASSTHROUGH step must preserve the returned response and therefore represent bodyBytes, eofObserved, and closeSucceeded as null, while retaining every other transport binding.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: The patched PASS branch requires all three fields to be exactly None after the unchanged action, state, sequence, status, round-trip, injected, and failureCode checks.

materialBoundaries.counterexample: A LOSS step supplies null, false, a boolean alias, or a float zero and bypasses the response-consumption evidence.
materialBoundaries.invariant: Each LOSS/INJECTED step must still prove an empty body, EOF, close success, one underlying round trip, status 204, injection, and no failure code.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: The patched LOSS branch uses integer(value,0,0) plus exact boolean identity checks, and focused actual-report mutants rejected null, false, boolean, and float aliases.

materialBoundaries.counterexample: A report with valid PASS nulls but a forged head relation, wrong actor, altered source, or failed privacy fence is accepted.
materialBoundaries.invariant: Changing PASS observation representation must not bypass the 31 HTTP originals, head, operation, recovery, cleanup, native-call, source, command, fsync, privacy, or fresh gates.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: The patch changes only the three observation checks inside fault(); all surrounding report and verify gates are unchanged, and direct validate_report replay returned the same 31-entry chain only after those gates passed.

protectiveFactors: Action, state, sequence, status, round-trip, injected, failureCode, outer snapshot, native-call, recovery-create, and 31-case business gates remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
LOSS still requires strict integer zero and boolean true observations; bool and float aliases for bodyBytes are rejected.
PASS now requires all three unavailable observations to be exactly null, so fabricated read or close metadata is rejected.
The production Go adapter and report producer are unchanged.

recoverability.rationale: The change is two Python files with no migration, persistence change, runtime state mutation, or compatibility encoding. Reverting the two hunks restores the prior reader behavior.

regressionLikelihood.rationale: The branch split exactly matches the source adapter: LOSS consumes and closes the response, while PASS returns it untouched. Exact-action and state checks remain before the observation split, and actual captured evidence plus 33 in-memory counterexamples exercised the change.

regressionProtection.rationale: The candidate has reported 300 CPU tests, strict patch application, direct replay of the actual 6d report, and focused counterexamples. A new exact-head Linux Go 31-request run and fresh checker have not yet run.

riskDrivers: The patch changes an acceptance contract for recovery evidence.
No new exact-head Linux Go or fresh workflow result exists yet.
Synthetic tests and implementation reside in the same Python contract module family.

statusQuoRisk.rationale: The current reader deterministically rejects source-defined PASS observations because it requires metadata that the passthrough branch intentionally cannot observe without consuming or closing the returned response.

unknowns.summary: A new integrated HEAD has not yet produced a real Linux 31-request report, source binding, original checker pass, and fresh replay pass.
